column1: # Hand-written translation facts, merged over the generated rows of shader_facts.tsv by dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py: key <TAB> facts JSON (same format)
# This game has no PC version, so the translator has no fragment output types and declares every output float; Metal refuses a pipeline whose float output meets an integer attachment
# (the host's red line then prints the row to add here).
# These pixel shaders write a value into colour target 5, which this game attaches as R8Uint (its shadow / lighting-channel mask), so each one needs its
# output 5 declared unsigned. 5,800 pixel shaders in the map write that target; the 323 below are the ones a device run has reached so far.
# Every key here is the host's own red line, from an iPhone running packages built on Windows (Kirby and the Forgotten Land 1.1.0): 137 in a short run,
# then 24 more in a 28-minute one, and 162 more in the session that reached the later areas -- the line prints only the first time a pipeline is
# created, so each run only reports what it reaches. dmsh_build.py's automatic integer entry point
# (fs_uint) does not cover these shaders -- they do not compute an output straight from as_type<float>(...) -- so the host falls back to this table.
